title: Qualities arise to compartmentalize and prioritize many needs

statements.text: The step from quantitative proto-mental states to qualitative mental ones comes with a specific kind of complexity. An organism with many homeostatic subsystems, for energy, oxygen, water and temperature, must compute their demands separately, which needs a qualitative differentiation of the sets of variables, a kind of color coding. When the relative value of needs changes over time and action forms a bottleneck, the needs must also be prioritized.

sources.quote: increasing complexity requires some form of compartmentalization of quantities
When it comes to action, executive choices must be made.
